What degraded

  • Shipped at the round cap at 7.446, 0.554 under the 8.0 top rung, after five rounds; no hard fail standing
  • Frame 5, the 48 submarket count, still stands in a void under a hard sky strip; judges named it every round
  • Frame 8's key reads 'lit at the low share' and 'lit at the high share' without naming the share (c36's range was cut from the dek in round 4)
  • Frame 9's email line sits over cabinet hardware; legible, four QA crossings it could not measure
  • Frames 1, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 were re-rendered after round 5 for a CI freshness repair, and so carry the kit's new shingled roof the judges did not see
  • The court (Middle District of North Carolina) is named on no frame; no close date is printed, on purpose
  • tx-2026-0088 kept its old stamp: Brazos County's own site answers 403

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Rent, recommended overnight, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Frisco is in this case two ways.

The complaint and the Justice Department's impact statement place Pinnacle Property Management Services there. Appendix A of the complaint lists Frisco as a market where it says aligned pricing harmed or is likely to harm renters.

Pinnacle licensed RealPage's AI Revenue Management. The complaint says it recommends a new price for every floor plan every night.

The proposed judgment isn't a ban on RealPage. What it cuts off is the data. Starting 180 days after the court enters its stipulation order, Pinnacle can't use pricing software fed by third-party nonpublic data or pooled across owners. It binds one landlord.

Comments go to the Justice Department's Antitrust Division within 60 days of the September 18th notice.

Should rivals' data be the line for every pricing algorithm in Texas, or only for one Frisco landlord?

#FriscoTX #RealPage #TunneyAct

Notes

The record: 44 of the 45 items due were re-verified and stamped, one primary source each. Brazos County's own site still answers 403, so tx-2026-0088 keeps its old stamp. Leander's Flock notice moved to its own detail address and both claims now cite it. Two decisions were admitted on primary sources: tx-2026-0189, the Justice Department's proposed judgment against Pinnacle Property Management Services with the Tunney Act comment window open, and tx-2026-0190, College Station's 4 to 2 vote to keep its Flock cameras. The deck: carousel no. 35 ships at the round cap at 7.446, 0.554 under the 8.0 top rung. Rounds 1 and 2 carried hard fails, each a sentence the source does not support (auto-accept "by default"; "the case against RealPage goes on"; "other defendants"), and each was repaired from the source's own words. Rounds 3 to 5 carried none. Still standing: frame 5's count stands in a void, frame 8's key never names the share it encodes, frame 9's email line sits over cabinet hardware, and the court is named on no frame. After the cap, a CI freshness repair re-rendered frames 1, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 with the kit's new shingled roof, so those shipped frames are not pixel for pixel the scored ones. Composition, copy and claims are unchanged; the run record says so and the score row reads STALE. A slip of the run's own: four early commits on this run's branch carried Claude attribution trailers, which CLAUDE.md forbids. They were rewritten on the unmerged branch with only those two lines removed (trees identical, author and Actor stamps intact) before anything reached main. Prompt audit (interim, Phase 17): exit 1, 1,884 tool calls measured and 567 over the one second line. The longest waits were 27.6 s and 25.7 s, the rest under 13 s. The no-stall hook was armed at 06:16:27 UTC, judged the session unattended from the start (the host's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED was 0) and refused nothing. No call waited long enough to have stalled the run. The Phase 19 reading follows in the notification.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
